purpose: Measure whether a Train-only, explainable ItemCF channel adds candidates missed by the fixed V2 scaled-cosine two-tower baseline before any merge, reranking, deployment, or long training decision.
hypothesis: Popularity-normalized item co-occurrence from Train interactions supplies complementary local-transition candidates, particularly for long-tail validation targets, without using any held-out interaction.

algorithm.weight: w_ij = sum_{u in U_ij} [1 / log(1 + |I_u|)] / sqrt(N_i N_j)
algorithm.user_score: S(u,j) = sum_{i in H_u} r(i,u) w_ij
algorithm.recency_weight: r(i,u)=1 for this channel-diagnostic; recency weighting is explicitly out of scope.
algorithm.training_data: Only the Train portion of the Train/Validation selection artifact; Validation targets and embargoed final interactions are excluded from index construction.

fixed_protocol.baseline: V2-BASELINE-001 exported normalized two-tower candidates at K=50
fixed_protocol.history: The same 10 encoded movie history entries exposed to each Validation query

report_only_metrics: ItemCF unique-hit rate: target is in ItemCF@50 and absent from two-tower@50
union Recall@50 with a fixed 25/25 two-tower/ItemCF round-robin quota
advancement_rule: This diagnostic cannot deploy or change the two-tower model. It may justify freezing a separate ItemCF merge candidate only if ItemCF has positive unique-hit count and the fixed-quota union improves overall Recall@50 without worsening AQ3 Recall@50 or Tail PQ0 Recall@50 by more than 0.002. The final V2 joint gates remain a separate preregistration before any deployment decision.
integrity_rules: Record a negative diagnostic and do not silently tune co-occurrence, history weighting, or merge quota after seeing the result.
Do not access, deserialize, or re-evaluate the sealed V1 Test split.
No existing experiment directory, model, log, or result may be overwritten.
